assertions.name: polynomial_factor_not_cyclotomic
assertions.source: (q-1-√2)(q-1+√2) = q²-2q-1; 1±√2 are not roots of unity

description: Compares Q_β's algebraic structure (Form A with silver-ratio factor q² - 2q - 1) against FSC's cyclotomic pattern (1/α_EM = q·[9]_q·[10]_q) and G's q-rational pattern (G(q) = q²/(q-1)⁴). Q_β lives outside the cyclotomic landscape — explains why no FSC-like closed-form derivation exists for c_4..c_7.

data.conclusion: Q_β admits NO clean cyclotomic / q-integer closed form. Its categorical source produces an irrational discriminant (q = 1 ± √2), distinct from FSC's cyclotomic torus knots and G's q-rational pole structure. The c_k precision-ladder IS the natural framework; no FSC-style derivation shortcut is available.
